items.description:
Our discussion categorizes existing MRS models into four critical aspects: Feature Extraction, Encoder, Multimodal Fusion, and Loss Function.
Check out our survey 📄A Survey on Multimodal Recommender Systems: Recent Advances and Future Directions, which contains a list of papers on multimodal recommender systems.
If you find this repository helpful to your work, please kindly star it and cite our survey paper as follows:
🤗 Contributions to update new resources and articles are very welcome!

We release the MRLib: A Continuously Updated Library for Advanced Models for Multimodal Recommendation.
We will continuously update MRLib with highly reproducible models from the latest papers on multimodal recommendation.
